name: Virag Instagram Creative Library
principles: Every output is an actual finished 4:5 Instagram advertising creative assembled from art-directed artwork, the exact product, visible 2D brand-design layers and a compact content hierarchy.
A beautiful product render, centered packshot, ecommerce scene or decorative 3D background is source artwork—not a finished creative.
Reject oversized duplicate products or labels in the background, generic glossy pedestals, abstract ribbons or arches as the whole idea, and background-only variations.
Use at least three intentional social-design layers such as frames, masks, color blocks, linework, textures, patterns, labels, badges or information cards.
Use exact supplied wording. If no copy is supplied, only exact readable product-name and label facts may appear as small support text; never invent claims or use a giant headline.
Preserve the complete product identity and generate every requested creative as a separate image.

commands.label: Fresh Instagram Post

commands.instruction: Generate one finished, full-bleed 4:5 Instagram feed post using only the current-turn product and references. Create a fresh social-native idea with a clear two-second hierarchy, balanced product scale, premium graphic language and natural mobile composition. Do not make a print poster, giant-title layout, flyer, plain product photo or background swap. MANDATORY SOCIAL ASSEMBLY: combine the art-directed base, exact preserved product, at least three intentional 2D brand-design layers, and a compact mobile content hierarchy in the same 4:5 canvas. Reject a centered packshot, ecommerce scene, oversized duplicate package or label in the background, generic glossy pedestal, decorative ribbons or arches as the entire concept, or any result without visible social-layout work.
